description: Returns one template's public details by slug: description, stack, tags, access level, tools it works with, licence note, live demo URL and preview image. Use this to inspect or compare a template before fetching it; it never includes the build prompt and never spends a credit. Use get_template_prompt for the prompt and search (kind templates) to find slugs. Read-only; an unknown slug returns an error.

slug.description: Template slug, exactly as returned by search (lowercase, hyphenated).

name: get_template

demo.description: Live demo URL, null when no demo exists

license.description: Licence summary for this access level

preview.description: Preview image URL, null when none

worksWith.description: AI builders and tools the prompt was tested with

title: Get template details
